subject: Geography and Cities, Menzoberranzan, Pillars of Woe
fact: The book *Geography and Cities, Menzoberranzan, Pillars of Woe* contains a footnote referencing a missing appendix.
source_quote: I found a footnote instead. "I gotta tell you, the first line of this, where it says, *Daz'issin*, and lit., *small shadow*, made me feel like I was reading, like, millennial shorthand. And that I didn't understand it." The footnote referenced an appendix.

subject: Geography and Cities, Menzoberranzan, Pillars of Woe
fact: The appendix of the book *Geography and Cities, Menzoberranzan, Pillars of Woe* was removed with a razor at least fifty years ago.
source_quote: The appendix was missing. I looked at the cut. It was mechanical. A razor. Not age, not water damage, not the slow forgetting of paper that has been handled too many times. A razor, at least fifty years ago, someone had taken to this book and removed what the footnote pointed to.
